research_scope: Primary official HDF Group format specifications only; no telescope requests, source HDF5 bytes, arrays, h5py or structural-parser execution.

conventions.O: unsigned little-endian object-address width from superblock
conventions.L: unsigned little-endian length width from superblock
conventions.undefined_address: all bits set in O-byte address
conventions.object_pointer_physical_location: base_address + stored_relative_address, subject to explicit format exceptions
conventions.superblock_EOF: absolute byte position, not base plus EOF
conservative_initial_implementation_rest: base address equals admitted signature position
Only explicitly decoded metadata pointer kinds
No raw dataset-layout or chunk-index traversal

superblock_v0.signature_locations: 0,512,1024,2048,...; candidate finite probe list must be prospective, not arbitrary signature scanning

object_header_v1.message_alignment: 8-byte within the object-header or continuation block; initial prefix already16-byte
object_header_v1.shared_flag: bit1 changes payload into shared-message encoding; unsupported shared payload must not be decoded as ordinary attribute/continuation

continuation.version1_target: message sequences only, without OCHK/OHDR magic or checksum

attribute_to_global_heap.version1_subfields: name, datatype and dataspace each independently round up to8; raw data follows without additional field padding
attribute_to_global_heap.version3_addition: name encoding byte after first8bytes; packed subsequent fields
attribute_to_global_heap.shared_attribute_datatype_or_dataspace: must decode supported shared encoding or fail closed; no interpreting shared bytes as a normal datatype
attribute_to_global_heap.typed_vlen_string: datatype class9; subtype1; character base; scalar/simple dataspace gives exact descriptor count

global_heap_collection_v1.index0_free_object_size: includes its own object header and remaining free allocation; unlike live data size
global_heap_collection_v1.object_count_not_stored: parse sequentially until index0 or declared collection end; no gaps except possible final fragment shorter than a header
global_heap_collection_v1.discovery: Only through typed metadata reference; GCOL collections neither form a discoverable linked list nor imply every matching byte signature is metadata

legacy_group_metadata.symbol_table_message: 0x0011: relative TREE address O + relative local HEAP address O
legacy_group_metadata.group_TREE: signature TREE, type0, level uint8, children_count uint16, sibling addresses O/O, alternating L-byte name-offset keys and O-byte children; N children and N+1 keys
legacy_group_metadata.leaf_children: level0 points to SNOD; higher levels point to same-type TREE at lower level
legacy_group_metadata.TREE_type1: raw chunk index; outside first structural metadata scope
legacy_group_metadata.SNOD: signature4, version1 uint8, reserved uint8, valid_entry_count uint16; valid entries only
legacy_group_metadata.HEAP: signature4, version0 uint8, reserved3, data_length L, free_offset L, data_relative_address O; relocated data must follow its address rather than assume immediate adjacency

compact_hard_link.flags: bits0..1 name-length-width selector1/2/4/8; bit2 creation-order uint64; bit3 link-type; bit4 charset; bits5..7 reserved
compact_hard_link.hard_link: bit3 clear; link name is length-delimited without NUL; target is O-byte object-header relative address
compact_hard_link.nonhard_links: soft/external/user-defined links require separate typed support or explicit rejection; not follow as object headers

implementation_policy_inferences: Every proposed missing byte fragment must name an admitted parent byte interval and its decoded pointer field/type.
A parser/cache miss by itself is insufficient authorization for remote fetch.
Ranges must be nonnegative, nonempty, within independently pinned file length and strict finite per-object/global byte caps.
Cycles, duplicate conflicting geometry, unknown unsupported versions/shared encodings, malformed count/length/reserved fields fail closed; no recovery via signature search.
Unsupported raw storage/chunk addresses are recorded as metadata descriptions without being proposed as fetches.

limitations: This note derives parser requirements from official specifications and is not evidence of any2019 file geometry.
Some historical editions label symbol-table name-offset width differently; admitted O=L=8 restriction avoids interpreting unequal widths.
The version1.0 global-heap wording is obsolete relative to version1.1/2.0/4.0; candidate supports GCOL version1 only.
